sections.title: Hotfix Update
sections.description: This is a hotfix update. Replay codes from the November 3 patch are still available.

sections.title: Competitive Play Updates
sections.description: - Reduced the maximum width of groups including Champion rank players from 4 to 3 in 6v6 Open Queue. This matches the maximum permitted width of Narrow groups containing Champion players in 5v5 Role Queue.
